events.title: Lebanon: Israeli strikes ‘could amount to international crimes,’ warns Türk
events.summary: UN Human Rights Chief Volker Türk expressed concern about ongoing displacement and destruction caused by Israeli strikes against Lebanon as he concluded a two-day visit to the country on Monday.

events.title: Guterres: Fast-tracking West Bank outposts is a ‘flagrant violation’ of international law
events.summary: The United Nations continues to monitor developments in the Occupied Palestinian Territory amid rising violence and greater restrictions in the occupied West Bank.

events.title: Security Council LIVE: Briefing on Ukraine as deadly Russian strikes hit cities and ports
